name: ExampleCo product information
summary: Demonstration index for a fictional product business. Replace every description and URL before publication.
guidance: For current capabilities, consult the product specification and plan matrix. Historical announcements describe availability at their publication date.
Interpret any price together with its currency, region, billing period, commitment, and product variant.
Distinguish generally available capabilities from beta features, optional add-ons, and planned features.
If a capability is not documented, identify it as unspecified. Preserve relevant limitations and prerequisites.
Each Markdown page should identify its corresponding public source page for attribution.
